Visa.metaDescription: Choose your country to see the documents, processing time and fees. WAAFA checks your papers, fills in the forms, books the appointment and follows the file.

list.lead: Choose your country to see the documents, processing time and fees. Send us your papers and we check them, fill in the forms, book the appointment and follow the file.

apply.documentsLead: Clear photos are fine. We tell you if anything needs to be redone.
